issues.desc: Comment bodies (untrusted user input) are rendered via renderMarkdown into dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitize(); renderMarkdown does not escape HTML, so /

Link rule copies the URL into href unchecked, allowing [x](javascript:alert(1)) and attribute breakout via quotes; renderer should escape HTML and allowlist URL schemes (counts if reported as part of the XSS finding).

useEffect dependency changed from [postId] to [] and the cancellation guard was removed: navigating to another post keeps showing the old post's comments, and late responses can overwrite state (race). Regression vs base.
key changed from c.id to array index; causes incorrect reconciliation when comments are inserted/reordered. Regression vs base.
Unique-author computation is O(n^2) (filter+findIndex) on threads with thousands of comments, recomputed every render; use a Set/Map (and useMemo).
Adds moment (large, legacy/maintenance-mode) when the project already uses date-fns and has relativeTime() in src/format.ts doing the same thing; duplicate functionality and unjustified dependency.
Only a bold happy-path test; no tests for HTML escaping / malicious input, links, or the components.

decoys.desc: Bio uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML but wraps the output in sanitize() (DOMPurify). This is safe; flagging Bio.tsx as XSS is a false positive.
